_how_to_use: Your own business, so the magic-or-annoying question gets answered on work you
actually care about. Copy this file first:
fill in seed_mine.json, then run:  /reset mine
- ids must be unique and keep their prefixes: p1.. people, pr1.. projects, t1.. tasks
- every task's project_id and assignee_id must match an id above it
- due_in_days / last_touched_days_ago are DAYS FROM TODAY, resolved on reset.
Negative due_in_days = already overdue. last_touched_days_ago = 9 means you
- estimate_hrs is your honest guess in hours. The agent plans against it, so a
fantasy number gets you a fantasy plan.
- waiting_on is the person id you're blocked on (often yourself). This plus
last_touched is how the agent finds bottlenecks and stuck work.
- 10-25 tasks is the sweet spot. Fewer and there's nothing to manage.
seed_mine.json is gitignored — it holds your real business and real people's names.

founder.name: YOUR FIRST NAME
founder.goal: the one outcome that matters in the next few weeks, in a short sentence

projects.name: a real project
projects.why_it_matters: one line on what breaks if this slips

tasks.title: a task you have actually been avoiding
a task someone else is blocked on you for
a task that is genuinely blocked on someone outside
tasks.notes: who or what you're waiting on, and since when
